evaluationConfig.description: KYC/AML-specific evaluators for UK-regulated banking agent. Aligned to MLR 2017, FCA Financial Crime Guide, JMLSG Parts I-III, and NCA SAR guidance.

evaluators.name: Sanctions Screening Precision
evaluators.description: Precision of sanctions matching against OFSI, UN, and EU consolidated lists. False negatives constitute potential regulatory breach under MLR 2017 Reg 86.

autoTighten.action: All sanctions matches require human review regardless of confidence score

evaluators.name: PEP Identification Accuracy
evaluators.description: Detection of Politically Exposed Persons, family members (MLR 2017 Reg 35(5)), and known close associates. Fuzzy matching via Levenshtein distance and phonetic algorithms (Soundex, Metaphone, Double Metaphone).

autoTighten.action: Reduce fuzzy match confidence threshold from 0.85 to 0.75, expanding candidate pool for human review

evaluators.name: UBO Chain Completeness
evaluators.description: Traces Ultimate Beneficial Ownership to required depth. UK PSC threshold: 25% (Companies Act 2006 s790C). Detects nominee structures, layered holdings, circular ownership, and bearer shares.

autoTighten.action: Reduce max ownership layer depth before mandatory escalation from 4 to 3

evaluators.name: Risk Score Calibration
evaluators.description: Validates predicted risk scores against actual outcomes. A score of X should mean X% of those cases genuinely warranted the assigned action. Measured via Brier score over rolling 90-day window.

autoTighten.action: Reduce auto-approval threshold from score <30 to score <20, expanding manual review pool

evaluators.name: Regulatory Completeness (FCA/PRA)
evaluators.description: Validates KYC assessment covers all required elements per MLR 2017, JMLSG Parts I-III, and FCA Financial Crime Guide Chapters 3-6. Checks CDD (Reg 28), EDD (Reg 33), source of wealth/funds, and ongoing monitoring triggers.

autoTighten.action: Add mandatory EDD for all cases scoring above medium risk, regardless of jurisdiction

evaluators.name: Source Document Grounding
evaluators.description: Every assertion in KYC assessment must trace to a specific source document (Certificate of Incorporation, audited financials, UBO declaration, passport, utility bill). No ungrounded claims. Per MLR 2017 Reg 28(3).

autoTighten.action: Reject any assessment containing more than 1 ungrounded assertion

evaluators.name: Jurisdiction Risk Assessment
evaluators.description: Correct application of FATF grey/blacklist status, Transparency International CPI scores, and local risk factors. Covers BVI, Cayman Islands, Jersey, Guernsey, Isle of Man, and other offshore centres.

autoTighten.action: Flag all FATF grey-list jurisdictions for mandatory EDD regardless of other risk indicators

evaluators.name: Transaction Pattern Analysis
evaluators.description: Detection of structuring (smurfing), rapid fund movement, round-tripping, layering, and integration signals in transaction history. Measured against known NCA SAR typologies and FATF red flags.

autoTighten.action: Lower structuring detection threshold from £9,000 to £7,500 and extend lookback from 30 to 60 days

evaluators.name: SAR Quality Score
evaluators.description: When SAR is recommended, validates draft meets NCA standards. Checks narrative completeness, correct categorisation (DAML/consent/intelligence), supporting evidence attached, and timeline accuracy. Per POCA 2002 s330-332.

autoTighten.action: Route all SAR drafts to MLRO for manual review before submission

evaluators.name: Decision Consistency
evaluators.description: Same input facts must produce same decision across repeated runs. Measures variance across 10 identical inputs — acceptable drift < 5%. Exceeding threshold triggers MLRO alert and pauses automated approvals.

autoTighten.action: Alert MLRO immediately + pause all automated approvals pending variance investigation
